big: Nifty Smallcap 50 is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

lines: What does the Nifty Smallcap 50 track?
The primary objective of the Nifty Smallcap 50 Index is to capture the movement of the smallcap segment of the market. It holds 50 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.
